dedupe_keys.name: drone extracted vehicle trajectories with co2 and noise emission estimates

description: Drone-extracted vehicle trajectories with CO₂ and noise emission estimates is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mobilysis. The datasets contain naturalistic vehicle trajectories collected by drones at a frequency of 30 datapoints per second. The datasets include per-second estimates of CO₂ and noise emissions, calculated using the MOVES and CNOSSOS models, respectively. The datasets include four vehicle types (Car, Bus, Truck, and PTW). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
